finding.comment: Every entrypoint resolves the workspace root through this resolver and no other mechanism, but the change shows only one entrypoint, so the universal claim cannot be verified.

input.title: cli: unify workspace-root resolution
input.body: Switches cli/main.py to the shared resolver so every entrypoint resolves the workspace root through one mechanism.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/cli/paths.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Workspace-root resolution contract.
+
+Every entrypoint resolves the workspace root through this
+resolver and no other mechanism.
+"""
+
+class WorkspaceRoot:
+    @staticmethod
+    def resolve():
+        raise NotImplementedError

--- /dev/null
+++ b/cli/main.py
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+from cli.paths import WorkspaceRoot
+
+
+def main():
+    root = WorkspaceRoot.resolve()
+    print(root)

rationale: same absolute wording as P3, but the change's own purpose is the unification and the shown entrypoint uses the resolver exclusively: the claim is substantiated in-diff
